title: QR Pixel
summary: A modern single-page QR code generator with a glass-style studio — create, customize, preview, and export pixel-perfect QR codes instantly.
overview: QR Pixel is a premium QR studio built with Next.js 16 and React 19. It supports multiple content types (URL, text, email, phone, Wi-Fi) with shared validation, a live customizable preview (colors, dot and corner styles, padding, logo upload, error correction, and backdrop patterns), and PNG/SVG export in multiple framed layouts. A GraphQL endpoint reuses the same validation and payload-builder logic as the UI.
highlights: Single-page QR studio with a glass-style interface for creating, customizing, previewing, and exporting QR codes.
Multiple content types — URL, text, email, phone, and Wi-Fi — with shared validation and payload generation.
Live preview with custom foreground, background, and card colors, dot and corner styles, padding, logo upload, error correction, and backdrop patterns.
PNG and SVG export with framed output and multiple layouts (square, portrait, desktop).
GraphQL endpoint for QR payload preview and generation, reusing the frontend's validation and payload builder.
Reliable DX and testing via Vitest, Playwright, Biome, and strict type checking.
